notes.title: Season 14: A World Divided
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41816713/f522b8d62bce99b2b699b92260427ce0d2a094d5.png"]"The battle between Shesha and Garuda shook the Three Worlds to their cores. Though a fragile order was restored by the intervention of Lord Vishnu’s divine champion, shadows rise once again as the Asura Kali, the Great Deceiver, reveals himself.

As Kali's corrupted legions scour the mortal worlds, the ancient Asura Ahi, the archenemy of heaven, has been resurrected to lay siege to all of heaven.

Beset on all fronts with the end of all existence almost certain, the gods themselves have chosen to retaliate.

Indra, Vayu, Bhumi, Surya and Varuna have initiated a call to arms to all the warriors of the three worlds, to join their armies as champions against injustice."

New Feature: Faction System
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41816713/58d066001cd8a4743b287f9ae063672e8511be14.jpg"]The bonds of the old world have broken, and 6 Legendary Unit cards have now become Heroes.

With this update, we introduce the Faction System—redefining how you can fight, strategize, and build your decks. Each Hero in game is now a part of a Faction where they align themselves to a god, good or evil.

Note: If you owned the legendary card before, we will unlock it's Hero version for you for free!

Detailed changes and balance changes are mentioned below.

New Season Pass!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41816713/bed8993748ac7f126e052d2bd2417e19a2f98402.png"]Forewarned by Lord Vishnu of a cataclysmic flood, King Satyavrata—the seventh Manu—built a great vessel to save his family and the seven sages. Anointed as a great rishi, his return now marks the turning of an age. His only duty: to maintain balance.

Check out the three new exclusive Neutral cards that come with this season in game!


The New Factions

Cards in each Faction will now be shared between the all the Heroes in that faction. The New Heroes come with a new power and passive which will unlock new ways to play with existing and new cards!

notes.title: Love and, Spring bloom in Season 12!
notes.content:
Lord Kamadeva’s arsenal is open to you…

Greetings Yodhas!

Flowers still bloom amidst the chaos of the Kaliyuga, as the seasons change and Spring arrives. The gardens echo with cheerful new tunes played by Gandharva musicians. And Lord Kamadeva, in the spirit of spring revelry, opens his arsenal to bestow upon the worthy a new weapon.

Adding to your Arsenal is Lord Kama’s spear, granting your Hero additional damage for every enemy charmed. And finally, Vasant, a new spell to rejuvenate your Hero. Vasant allows you to regain all Soma during its turn, and draw two cards.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c31668_01c845bddc5e4b9e82980a19e1ce2e96~mv2.png

Lord Kama’s Spear is a new neutral weapon card that gives your Hero +1 Damage for every opponent charmed. Its neutral status means it can be equipped by all Heroes available in-game. We can already think of some synergies players can try with the new spell entering the card pool!

The Himastra, a mysterious Astra of unknown origin was unearthed in the sacred mountains, wieldable by any that dares.

Hero Changes

Arjuna

Arjuna’s Gifted Passive now triggers only once per turn

Admittedly, even though it’s fun to chain Spells together, given the limited counters to it, we felt Arjuna’s passive required some intervention. We understand that most Arjuna decks rely on this for their win condition, but for now, we will be monitoring win rates closely till the next balance patch.

Bheem

Impatience has been reworked.

Old: (4 Soma) Draw 2 cards. They cost 2 less this turn.
New: (3 Soma) Draw 1 card. It costs 1 less.

Surpanakha

Stay A While has been reworked.

Old: Charms last one turn longer.
New: Charmed Units have +3 damage.

Living Shield reworked: No longer blocks effects that destroy.
Mirage reworked: Can now be triggered only once. Reduces Soma cost of Unit by 2.
Ignite reworked: Deal +1 damage for each status effect on the target.
Heals All reworked: Healing reduced to 1.
Charm reworked: Charmed Unit returns to its owner whenever it takes damage. (Cards with special Charm effects remain the same.)
Silence reworked: Silence can be removed with Purge and other negative buff-removing effects.
Attacks now remove effects like Living Shield, Distract, etc. even if they deal 0 damage.
Hero Powers are now blocked by Spell Immunity.

Neutral Cards

Forest Yaksha: now has Purge
Naga Archer: now has Purge.

notes.title: Dawn Of The Suryaputra: Karna Is Here!
notes.content:
Dawn of the Suryaputra

“WHERE IS KARNA?”

Not a day goes by without our passionate players asking us this question. Our response has been long overdue, but the sheer greatness of the incomparable Golden Warrior needed our entire team to level up and rise to the challenge. 

The wait is finally over! Karna… is here.

The most anticipated hero in Kurukshetra: Ascension’s history joins the fray today. Now, it is your turn, Yodha, to rise to a challenge of your own. Only the masterful can harness the wildfire that is the Suryaputra. Are you ready?

Karna, the son of the Sun God Surya, has arrived to set the battlefield ablaze. The brothers who once humiliated and rejected him will now face his fiery wrath! From his glowing Kundala and burning Kavach, to unique new mechanics, and an entirely new faction under his command, Karna brings the heat!


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_aef62cf5ef3148628c83cd3caec99ea4~mv2.png

Karna: Abilities Overview

Base Stats: Karna begins a game with 25 HP, 1 Damage, and 0 Armour, with his legendary Kavach being obtainable through a Spell Card. 

Hero Power - Arrow Spray: Aim for the heavens and scorch anyone who stands in your way! Arrow Spray deals 1 damage to all enemies on the board.

Hero Passive - Sacrifice: There's no sacrifice too great when victory is at hand! Drag a card from your hand to the Soma Counter to receive 1 Soma for that turn.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_4ea7fe158e444949a0f305cd8c07317d~mv2.png

Night Mode:

Unleash Karna’s full potential with impressive builds in Night Mode. Karna’s playstyle in Night Mode follows three loosely defined paths. Nine new Night Cards open up possibilities to burn your opponents, buff your units' damage, and build epic combos. We can’t wait to see the unique strategies and decks our players come up with. 

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_ef6afcd214bb4588977e18fed9fed4ba~mv2.png

New Faction:

The Asura… creatures engulfed by the darkness who once fell to the raging might of the Sun God. Now, they bow to the Suryaputra. Terrifyingly feral, the Asura are hard-hitting units with a compelling new property. “Cursed” is a double-edged sword that forces the unit to transfer 1 damage every turn to opponents. However, proficient strategists can find ways to retain this damage for themselves!

The Asura are a mechanically complex faction we’ve designed in tandem with a branch of Karna’s Night Cards.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_1ee27cdd4fce412d93be203095f9c361~mv2.png

Unlocking Karna:

Karna is our first Premium Hero, requiring a test of skill to unlock. To unlock Karna with Shards, players must first win 35 duels.

Going forward, all new Heroes will be Premium Heroes at launch, as the complexity of Hero mechanics has gradually increased over time. With this change, we aim to help new players ease into the basics of Kurukshetra: Ascension before they accidentally unlock more complicated Heroes.

However, for those who wish to unlock Karna right away, a Hero Bundle is available in the Store. The Karna Hero Bundle includes exclusive Avatars, three Legendary Cards, Hero Progression, and instant access to Night Mode.

Head over to the in-game store now!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_db6b3888b0dc483ab094d4c058910a3b~mv2.png

This is an experimental change as we felt that damage over time effects such as Burning and Bleeding can be too punishing if players do not have cleanse cards in their deck. We are looking into some updates to damage over time effects as a whole to make it slightly more strategic and balanced.

Wasn't that the best surprise? We thank you for your patience in waiting for him, and hope you're as excited as we are to play as Karna! We won't keep you here today Yodhas, go play Kurukshetra: Ascension!

notes.title: Heroes: Rediscovery
notes.content:
Greetings Yodhas!

The Heroes: Rediscovery update is upon us! Get ready for significant early-game impact, improved synergy between Heroes and Units, a superior Hero levelling experience and Legendary cards that truly impress.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_4d171a9b2dd741669567bd1c5d00b223~mv2.png

Hero-Balancing And Passives

It was fun while it lasted, but Hero damage previously allowed players to ramp up to extraordinary values, reducing the effectiveness of Unit Cards, including coveted Legendary units. Battles were often reduced to a Hero brawl, and the strategic depth of Kurukshetra: Ascension often fell by the wayside.

We have now lowered Hero damage across the board while also removing the Soma cost for hero weapon attacks. Passives like ‘Rising Storm’ that buffed damage without a cap have been altered. Weapons, Cards, and Powers that provide damage buffs still exist but are now harder to obtain. While this may sound unpleasant at first glance, our testing has shown significantly greater Hero-Unit synergy and card impact. Your decks are powerful now and rightly so. We cannot wait to see what our players cook up.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_b0e058e3c8964eae8cdd3f7cd72e683f~mv2.png

The Early-Game Impact

“1-cost units are useless!”. We heard that feedback a lot and we agree! Hero damage and armour were too strong previously, and that brave Warrior’s damage was often blocked entirely.  This was further backed by a lack of variety in low-cost units. Heroes were also able to ramp up damage very quickly in the early rounds, leaving starting Units in the dust.

Our solution is to remove Armour from Heroes, though some like Duryodhana and Surpanakha can still receive armour buffs from different cards in the mid-game. We’ve also significantly reduced Armour gain potential from our Ranged Heroes, as Row Protection was always meant to be a key strategic element in keeping them safe.

Finally, the starting player now begins with 2 Soma! Something our player base has been waiting to hear for a while. This opens up strategic depth right from round one, while also allowing low-cost units to influence the battle!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_32903f428aec4520974b9834ba2a56cd~mv2.png

Hero Levelling

Hero cards weren’t being used to their full potential, with player feedback pointing to a difficulty in obtaining them being the root cause. Getting locked out of grabbing a specific Hero card just wasn't fun and limiting a Hero's true potential.

Hero Cards are back on the heroes individual progression track, with a few new ones being added along the way! These cards have also been removed from card packs, making it easier for you to snag the units you’ve been looking for. When you check your Hero track, you’ll also notice new avatars for these Hero-specific cards that you can proudly wear as a badge of honour.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_7fc080b22f03422185f3d3e2ed79bf97~mv2.png

Legendary Cards 

Legendary Cards were powerful but often lacked utility or synergy with other units. Some were exceedingly dominant, while others saw far less use. We want players to be able to build decks around any Legendary in their inventory, instead of having to wait endlessly for that specific card.

To tackle this, we have completely overhauled Legendary Cards. They now synergize with far more properties and factions than before, along with the addition of new properties that bring depth to gameplay. 

We’ve been playtesting these changes and having a blast! The late-game possibilities are endless, and we’re waiting for players to break the game with their unique decks and builds.

Now, let’s move on to discussing each hero and how we’re innovating their gameplay to new heights!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_d374e826712e4910a35989b53aa020c1~mv2.png

Arjuna

Arjuna’s might and prowess on the battlefield came from his bow, and of course the many Astras in his arsenal, we want our hero to reflect that. Along with other adjustments, Arjuna has a new passive, Gifted.

New Passive, Gifted: Draw a card when you cast a spell. 

Base Stats: 1 Damage, 0 Armour, 20 Health

New Cards: 

Brihannala: New Spell Card, Charm an enemy with 3 Health or less.
Ulupi:  New Legendary Unit, Passive: All poison attacks reduce damage by 3.

Cards reworked:

Shock Archer: Is now a neutral card. Health increased to 3 from 2.
Savyasachi: Damage reduced to 2 from 3.
Snipe: Soma Cost increased to 4 from 3.
Gandiva: Now increases Heroes base damage by +2. No longer makes Arjuna Counter-Immune.
Execute: Soma cost reduced to 2 from 3.
Lightning Bolt: Damage reduced to 4 from 5.
Satyaki: Now gives Guard to all Legendary Units.
Abhimanyu: Now buffs the health of all other Humans by +3.
Shivas Doom: Soma cost reduced to 8 from 10.
Chakra: Now increases Heroes base damage by +1. No longer has Concealed Weapon. Soma cost reduced to 2 from 3.
Airavat: Soma cost increased to 9 from 8. Health increased to 9 from 7. Now gains +1 damage for each enemy Stunned during the game and is Spell Immune.
Elite Army: Soma cost reduced to 2. Now draws a Legendary card from your deck and reduces its cost by 2.
Indra's Shot: Soma cost reduced to 1 from 3.
Focused Shot: Damage reduced to 3 from 4. Soma cost reduced to 2 from 4. Can now only attack the enemy Hero.
Divine Student: Increased Soma cost reduction of spells from 1 to 2.
Divine Double:	Changed to Rapid Assault: If a Spell kills an enemy, create a free copy in hand
Devadatta Conch: Now gives +2 damage to all Ranged Units for one turn.
Eager Students: Changed to Flawless: Arjuna becomes counter-immune.
Guard Me Changed to Piercing Attacks: All allies have Pierces.

Removed Cards:

Lightning Tips, Discharge, Piercing Arrows, Manavastra and Vritra’s Bane.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_15ad74c8e13a45fba8e9c6e3a7754c2e~mv2.png

Sugriva

Sugriva was perhaps capable of the highest damage ramp-up, with the Shikari Gada and Tribe making his playstyle very one-dimensional and focused only on Hero to Hero attacks, we’re tackling that by adjusting his passive along with a few other tweaks. 

New Passive, Flanks: Sugriva now Flanks.

Base Stats: 2 Attack, 0 Armour, 30 Health.

Cards reworked:

Angada: Now deals 4 damage and has 4 Health. Soma cost reduced by 1 per Vaanar deployed.
Nila: Gains +2 dmg/ +2 Health when opponent casts a spell. Damage and Health increased by 1.
Nala: Weapons cost -2 Soma.
Golden Vaanar: Soma cost increased to 5 from 4.
Sushena: Soma cost increased to 8 from 7. Now Silences all enemy Units on Deploy.
Sanjeevani changed to: Grant a Unit +3 Health. Soma cost increased to 2 from 1.
Hanuman's Aid: Heal all friendly Units fully; Vaanars and Beasts gain Self-Revive.
Frenzied Tail: Damage reduced to 2 from 3.
Rama's Shot: Now deals piercing damage equal to your current Soma.
Forest Cover: Now also has draws a card.
Shikari Gada: Now increases Heroes base damage by +1. Ability removed. Now Poisons.
Kaumodaki: Now increases Heroes base damage by +2.
Flaming Sabotage renamed to Sabotage: Now has Draw 2 cards.
Forest Mantra: Cost reduction increased to -2 from -1.
Camouflage changed to Healer's Grove: All healing increased by 2.

Removed Cards:

Leap, Mighty Leap and Surya’s Blessing.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_c7c3a509a66e4849a8fad1afb894d309~mv2.png

Bhishma

Bhishma, in his previous avatar, was too dependent on the opponent deploying units to build damage, not just limiting his own playstyle, but also the opponents. His new passive allows him freedom to attack anyone on the battlefield without fear of retaliation!

New Passive, Pitamah: Bhishma is now counter immune. 

Base Stats: 1 Damage, 0 Armour, 20 Health

New Cards: 

Ganga's Disciple: New Legendary Unit, +2 to all healing effects.
Sarala: New Legendary Unit, On Deploy: Charm any Unit till death; Charms last 1 turn longer.
Sentinel: New Legendary Unit, Guards and Spell-Immune.
Pauravi: New Legendary Unit, Ranged units cost -2 Soma.

Cards reworked:

Kankastra: Now only smashes 1 armour.
Bhishma's Boon: Soma cost reduced to 2. Health buff increased from 4 to 5.
Cheat Death: Soma cost reduced to 6 from 7.
Apsara: Renamed to Court Apsasra: Charm threshold increased to 5 health from 4. Health increased to 6 from 5.
Gangaputra: Soma cost increased to 6 from 5.
River of Arrows: Soma cost increased to 8 from 7.
Pushpa Dhanu: Now increases Heroes base damage by +1. On attack: Reduces enemy damage by 2.
Kaundinya: Now increases Heroes base damage by +2. Is no longer counter-immune. Soma cost reduced from 7 to 6.
Freezing Arrow: Renamed to Ice Arrow.
Ganga's Embrace: Health buff reduced from 5 to 3. Soma cost reduced to 2 from 3.
Commander: Unit cost reduction is now -1 per turn instead of -2.
Healing Waters: Healing reduced to 2 from 4.
Deep Freeze: No longer increases damage on frozen enemies. Now frozen enemies are stunned when damaged.
White Warrior changed to Spirit Warrior: Bhishma gains lifesteal.
Cleanse changed to Daze: Target has -2 Damage this turn.
Ranged Dominance: Damage increase reduced to +2 damage from +4 damage. Note: With this passive players won't be able to deploy melee Units as was intended earlier. (This might be changed in the upcoming balance patch.)
Pitamaha changed to Devavrata: Bhishma becomes Spell-Immune.

Removed Cards:

Scarlet Streams, Praswapastra, Divine Light, Ayurveda, Resolve, Flash Flood, Ice Weapons and Icy Breath.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_bd05d60571c04312ac58acd1f543720d~mv2.png

Duryodhana

With lower soma cost units receiving significant tweaks, Duryodhana’s current passive puts him in a great place as we’ve balanced the Balachita as well. Previously Balachita’s damage bonus when an ally died lasted the entire match, we’ve adjusted this to only last during the turn the unit dies. https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_5d388658c1df4373a4dd808c7cf21197~mv2.png

Beating tougher opponents will earn you a lot more Dharma but be warned, losing to weaker opponents could cost you dearly.

notes.title: The Apsara Court is our Biggest Update Yet!
notes.content:
Mesmerize the battlefield during the season of The Apsara Court! Let's dive into our biggest update yet![

Greetings Yodhas!

I hope that marching hasn’t tired you out Yodhas, as we have quite the journey before us! We visit The Apsara Court this season, to encounter a new faction of divine performers. Eleven new cards are entering the card pool, with two new properties. Realms have received some major reworks focusing on an elevated roguelike experience. New card frames, a new board, and an overhauled quest system are now live, so let’s just dive into this huge update.

New Karma Pass: The Apsara Court

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_d8110703d2bf40ec86babae9c990f7d6~mv2.jpg

New Cards

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_98e07d119b004d909eecb8c3dfed48e5~mv2.jpg

Grab the all-new Karma Pass to instantly unlock THREE cards! Shakuntala, her lover Dushyanta, and their iconic Royal Ring. Scale up the track to unlock the distractingly beautiful Urvashi, who allows you to choose and draw legendary cards from your deck. Hit level 100 to unlock Ghritachi, to prevent your units from being charmed, while also being counter immune! New Apsara cards have also been added to the card pool, so good luck when you open your next card pack!

New Properties

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_0c75f18107cc4578a7f3a45daec91207~mv2.jpg

Two new properties enter the game this season: Beloved, a tactician's dream, buffing other units' damage when your beloved unit takes damage. Distract, when timed well, makes your opponent's unit damage useless. 

Realm Rework

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_0c3633b5c2f2494ba796bf9fb9d385ce~mv2.jpg

The next time you load into a realm, things are going to look a little different. New pathways and new challenges await you, with different opponents to choose from on these alternate paths. Replaying a realm has its own rewards too, with shortcuts opening up that allow players to skip certain opponents on their run. A few new mechanics have been added to the campaign such as Card Shuffle, The Forge, Mystery Nodes, and the Mini Store. 

Card Shuffle changes the way cards are added to your campaign deck. If at the end of the battle, a player isn’t satisfied with the cards offered to them, they can now reroll to get more options!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_f172c913b8eb4ae99dbbed8873cebe2d~mv2.jpg

The Forge is where you personalize your starter deck. Defeating bosses will earn you forge points which allow you to edit one card in your starter deck per point. These changes are permanent through your future runs. Some forge points can also be present on the map so be on the lookout!

 https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_0963762348544276867752dc32ff25b8~mv2.jpg

Players will now also encounter Mystery Nodes along the way. These unique nodes on the map are a small break from fighting and allow the player to gamble with their fate. The result can either buff or curse you. Are you willing to take a risk?

 https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_303fafdf513a41fb806f949ef5a24b6f~mv2.jpg

The Mini Store is where you can grab some power-ups Yodha! You’ll notice this cart carrying useful wares along your journey. And after hearing player feedback on permadeath, Amrith is being re-added to the game, to give you a second wind when you fall, along with other boosts and consumables. 

New Card Frames

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_25394471720e4ce1a70b960c4d5ffd0c~mv2.jpg

Card frames have received an upgrade! Our new stylized border draws inspiration from historical Indian art, while also clearly communicating card rarity. With gray being used for common cards, blue for rare cards, purple for epic cards, and ancient gold for legendary cards. 

New Board Design

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_268cc558358146768ee48ede6a763e15~mv2.jpg

Your hero now fights directly on the battlefield! Their hero powers have been moved to the left, along with new frames around the hero portrait. The board itself now feels more fluid based on the attack type of the heroes being played and will adapt based on melee or ranged heroes being played. Icons have been added to represent row types, with the range row now appearing slightly raised over the melee row. These changes now make your board truly feel like a battlefield! Icons and board UI have also been slightly refreshed.

Quest Rework

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1156887237447929937/1180752063311925342/image47.png?ex=657e900d&is=656c1b0d&hm=dfbe76baf260e85d1c51dd8c076e83a76bfcf789740604d27a382d6a39ebf15b&

Our quest system has been overhauled completely to reward daily playtime. Log in every day and grab yourself some easy Karma by completing daily tasks. These roll over to the next day once you have made some progress on them. You will now also receive one large quest that you can spend the week completing. This quest, however, does not roll over into the next week, so make sure you complete it for a large chunk of Karma!

Play Your Way

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_06dd70b7f19a42359de9a2aea8efb373~mv2.jpg

Player choice has been a high priority for us in this update, and we’re changing the way players can approach Kurukshetra: Ascension. On completing the tutorial the Ascension storyline and PvP queue unlock together. So, go ahead and play your way Yodhas!

New Animations

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_1d877f0035be4402af66daf9f1640f49~mv2.gif

We’re constantly working on improving the visual experience when playing Kurukshetra: Ascension. The forge is one example of the animations we’re overhauling, maps feel more alive, as nodes like the forge build onto the map.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_f05705ef61594adfabdbde9209d14870~mv2.gif

Attack animations have all been updated, and attack properties such as Pierce and Smash are going to look and feel even better than before! Hop in-game to check out all of them.

Balance Changes

notes.title: Hotfix: 12th October
notes.content:
Gameplay
- Properties will now be applied even if attacker damage is 0
- Defending target will now counterattack even if their damage is 0
- Defenders will not counterattack if the attacker has Charms, even if they cannot switch due to space constraints

Dev Note: Until now, if the net damage inflicted by a Unit or Hero was 0, properties such as Stuns, Bleeds, etc. did not apply on the target. For e.g if a Shock Archer with 2 damage attacks a Unit with 2 Armour, the target Unit did not get stunned since it took 0 damage. We've decided to let the property apply even if the damage is 0 as it was causing some unforeseen edge cases which led to game desyncs and freezes. We understand that this might cause a slight shift in overall balance but there are more changes planned for future updates 

Hotfix

- Pradyota now correctly does not get Tapasya buff even after attacking
- Fixed an issue with Arjuna's divine double causing issues if the hand is full
- Fixed an issue with Alpha causing a freeze if the opponent health was higher than Bheem's

Greetings Yodhas!

For it’s time to step off the ground and demonstrate aerial dominance with our latest seasonal offering, Flight Of Freedom. New Unit Frame Art

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_0e0ee9c00dc746edb06f62019232fb5f~mv2.png

In order to give more importance to armour, we've given a fresh look to the Unit card frames. Our goal was to maintain simplicity while improving the overall attractiveness of the game board, especially when multiple units are deployed. This change also ensures better visibility of stat icons.

New Feature: Bazaar

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_d9b3174a0bc846e69e4793fc9ef3a840~mv2.png

A trader has set up shop in the game store! Bazaar is a new in-game feature that allows players to use their hard-earned shards to purchase specific cards and experience boosts! This addition aims to offer players more options in crafting their ideal decks faster without over-relying on the card packs.

New Cosmetic Items

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_fe115ed7c8f74ba18c88180eab1a1e0a~mv2.jpg

Game boards from the story mode are now available to use in duels!  You can now purchase and customize your board in the game (your half will look different from your opponent's – mix and match!). We are still working on several hero skins and card backs which will be introduced in a future update.

League Update

We've made small changes to the League system. It was very punishing for players to reach and stay in Immortal. We've made it so that players who reach Immortal now can no longer be demoted but their Karma will carry over to the next week so that player's who made it to immortal early will have an edge.

Balance Changes

Bheem

Bheem's performance has been pretty balanced in the current meta. The one design change we wanted to make was his abundance of Smash which makes certain cards redundant. We are still debating on how we can make his other smash cards more viable but for now we thought the best thing would be to remove Smash from one of his weapons and give it Overkill.

- Vrigodharam: Smash replaced with Overkill
- Wind-up: Fixed an issue where the damage was being granted immediately rather than on weapon attack.

Bhishma

Bhishma has been significantly underperforming in the meta. The negative effects of certain night cards far outweighed the positive effects and thus have been removed. While we hope to see a much better win rate for him with these changes, we will be closely monitoring the abilities for swift correction if the need arises.

The original design for Sugriva was to promote synergies with other Vaanar and Beast for a more unit-oriented playstyle. While his passive was intended to make up for the loss of key units and combo dangerously with his weapons, the damage ramp became too high, especially because it could boost even his base weapon which cannot be disarmed. This resulted in the ability to ramp up damage to very high amounts easily and without counter. With this change we hope to shift towards a more balanced playstyle where Sugriva will have enough defense to develop board control and rely on weapons to inflict damage directly.

notes.title: New Realm: Prithvi, Night Mode and UI changes!
notes.content:
Greetings Yodhas!

Home is calling, the realm of man, vaanar and beast launches with this update, Prithvi! This update doesn’t just stop at a new realm but also brings a rework to our core card combat. We are redefining our meta and adding a unique mechanic carefully designed for Kurukshetra: Ascension. With player experience as our priority, the first rollout of our UI update and animation updates have also been implemented with this patch, along with some hero changes we hope to structure and balance the game with our new unique game mode in mind.

Let’s dive into it!

New Realm: Prithvi

The realm of mortals brings with it three distinct kingdoms, each with their own trials, twists and challenges, we did not want to make this one easy! Journey first to the Khandava forest, under Lord Indra’s protection, where you’ll face off against the mythic beasts of the realm. The first boss you encounter will be a known face to those enjoying the Tribes of Kishkindha Karma Pass with the ferocity of Jambavan to contend with.

The next stop along your hero's journey would be Kishkindha, home of the mighty Vaanar Sena. Leap and climb your way through the treehouses and vines until you meet your final champion, but we have  added a twist to keep this bout interesting. 

Lastly, contend with the champions of Magadha, the great bastion of humanity, now in turmoil. Make your way to the Rajgriha and challenge the King, but we don’t want to spoil the rest. Enjoy the Prithvi Realm on our stunning new board, and we can’t wait for you to play it.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_662b4ff00e6f48ffad2ccec7214e10d9~mv2.png

Night Mode:

We’re in the Endgame now. We are redefining the way players approach combat with an overhaul to our core gameplay. Available to a Hero that has reached level 20, Night Mode. Inspired by our namesake, the great Kurukshetra war and battles of old, players are given time to strategize upon nightfall. 

After playing 4 turns each, day turns to night on the battlefield. Turn five will be played by both players at the same time. This means you and your opponent will be playing actively not just to counter each other, but to make moves with the new cards being added that can be played on “night” turns. During this time both players make card and buff choices to strengthen their strategy.

This addition to card based combat is our approach to adding a mechanic unique to Kurukshetra: Ascension. Meta breaking and rebuilding is our goal and your feedback during this shakeup is going to shape the future of Kurukshetra: Ascension!

Stay tuned for more announcements about this game mode and check out the new card design coming with it! 

Note: There is a known bug where in your very first night battle there is a small chance that your choice will get skipped. This will occur only on your first battle.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_ae482503b5bf483c98abb56f0b9ec42f~mv2.png


New UI and Animations:

We take player experience very seriously with every feature in the game, be it old or new. Our new UI aims to do much more than functionality - We have also crafted a new visual language inspired by thousands of years of Indian design.

We start this with a lobby refresh, where you can see new buttons and a visual aesthetic that fits with the core identity of Kurukshetra: Ascension. Check out the new buttons, hero portraits and more.

Card pack reveals needed to capture the epicness of earning that sweet sweet reward at the end of it. So, we’re rolling out a new graphic, animation and an announcer for extra pizazz. Now it feels oh-so much more satisfying when you find that legendary you’ve been chasing.

These are just a part of our UI updates with more to roll out over the course of future patches.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_dcd209b4abdd4c15805be25135dbf67d~mv2.png

Balance Changes:

We've been noticing aggressive playstyles performing relatively better than others and certain neutral cards being widely used by all Heroes.

While this is not necessarily a bad thing, we feel it limits the uniqueness of the gameplay that each Hero has to offer, especially if these cards comprise a large portion of their decks.

So, we've decided to make some minor changes to the following cards...

Arjuna

Discharge cost reduced from 3 to 2 Soma.
Manavastra now pierces as well.
Execute cost reduced from 5 to 3 Soma.
Gandiva now does not pierce.

Duryodhana

Gandhari’s Blessing cost increased from 2 to 3.
Scavenger cost reduced to 3.
Envy cost reduced from 2 to 1 Soma.
Revenge now deals 5 damage to an enemy that attacked you last turn.

Bheem

Spotter is now a 0-0-4 ranged unit.

Flex now affects Heroes.
Tree Hurl smashes 1 instead of 2.

Bhishma

Freezing Arrow can now target heroes.
Barrage can now Pierce.

Surpanakha

Charm now lasts until the end of your next turn.

Betrayal cost reduced to 0 Soma

Neutral
Blood Bag (Buff reduced from 3 to 2 Health)
Knife Throw (Damage reduced from 3 to 2)
Noose of Pain (Cost increased from 4 to 6) 


All that being said? We haven’t been able to cover everything here and hope to see you discover the rest when playing the campaign! We hope you enjoy the new realm update and look forward to suggestions and feedback. notes.title: Game Optimization and Balance Update
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone!

While we are aware that everyone is anxious to see the new Hero Sugriva in action, we've had to take a detour in development which we feel was critical in the long run of the game.

This detour we took was for Game Optimization and Balance Changes.

Game Optimization

Game Optimization means that we went deep into our game files and cleaned them up thoroughly. Think of it as a yearly deep clean of your home after which everything feels fresh and new.

We identified a few bottlenecks that were impacting game execution the most and restructured them.
The result should be a much better game performance especially on relatively lower end devices.

So, you can expect to see a much smoother gameplay! 

Major Balance Changes

We have been closely monitoring the Hero Weapon meta that has developed in PvP.

While we intended weapons to be powerful, the ramp up to high amounts of weapon damage was easily achieved without any consequence and in most cases resulted in limiting the number of viable options for both players.

One of the biggest issues that came to light was that deploying most units generally became disadvantageous. 

So, to address this core problem we've introduced a new Card Property: Disarm

New Property and Game Mechanics

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/73f836_c1a6236d188a45f094dc87573ecb7193~mv2.png

Disarm: Returns enemy weapon to their hand. Removes all Weapon buffs.

Units with Disarm when deployed cause the enemy Hero's weapon to return to their hand.

Additionally, we have divided the Hero Damage modifiers in two parts:
1. Hero Buff
2. Weapon Buff

Spells and Powers which increase damage through Weapon Buff will be removed if disarmed.

For example, Weapon Enhancement (Vriddhi) is now a Weapon Buff. This means if a Hero used Weapon Enhancement but later gets disarmed, the +2 damage from it will be lost.

But Duryodhana's Spell Balarama's Blessing which gives +1 damage is now a Hero Buff and will not be affected by disarm.

All damage can still be reduced through poison.


Quests

While with these changes we hope to bring long term benefits to the game, due to this detour we have unfortunately not been able to revamp the new quest system. 

Since the new quest system was designed to completely overhaul the existing one, we are at a stage where we cannot implement the old quest system.

This means that No quests will be working till we release the next update

While we know this is not the best experience, we hope that everyone can be patient a little longer for the next update to bring in the new quest system.


Detailed List of Balance Changes

Card Properties

All status effects like Freeze, Bleed, Burn, Stun, etc. now apply on Heroes, but no longer stacks in intensity.

Begin your journey to Mount Meru where a war rages between the demigods, Shesha and Garuda.

notes.title: Brand New Year, Grand New Updates!
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors!

With the advent of the new year, we at Studio Sirah would like to introduce some major updates to the game!


New Spell Cards, Easier Hero Levelling and Card Properties
We've introduced brand new Spell Cards for all Heroes! 

The level reward system has been restructured to accommodate for these cards and we've reduced the experience required for each level, making it slightly easier for players to level up their Heroes.

We are introducing two new Card Properties:
Charm - Temporarily converts an enemy unit
Freeze - Frozen units take +2 damage

If you log in to the game, your existing Heroes might be at a higher level than before with some new cards for you to use in battle!

New Hero Mechanics
All Heroes now start the game with a base weapon.

Melee Heroes start with a Punch and Ranged Heroes with a Bow, which can be upgraded to do more damage by deploying their existing Weapon cards. 

Our thought process behind this change was that despite the whole game revolving around the Heroes, players had a limited way of interacting with them which somewhere made it feel as if they were not part of the battle. So, this feature makes it so that your Heroes can attack right from the start and feel more active on the battlefield.

New Game Visuals
We did a complete overhaul on the Game Board visuals. This means brand new graphics, card frames, unit deployment, targeting and much more! 

(No more dragging your card to long away distances just to have it deployed in a pre-defined location.) 

Note: We have reset the Dharma rating for everyone to make room for the new and upcoming PvP League System.
